name: Vedant Fashions Limited
summary: Vedant Fashions Limited makes, trades and sells wedding and celebration wear, with markets including India, Nepal, North America, the UAE and the UK. It offers kurta sets, sherwanis and jackets for men, lehengas, sarees and gowns for women, and outfits for children. Its labels are Manyavar, Mohey, Twamev, Diwas and Mebaz, sold through franchised and multi-brand outlets.
